alt_text: Visitors walk across the tiled plaza of Seville's Plaza de España, with its brick Renaissance Revival palace, tall tower, fountain, and canal under a clear blue sky. in Roma Norte, Mexico City. Text on the image: False friends: words that look Spanish but aren't
caption:
False friends: words that look Spanish but aren't. • embarazada ≠ embarrassed (pregnant)
• actually ≠ actualmente (in fact)
• library ≠ librería (biblioteca)
• assist ≠ asistir (help)
